subject: Post-call: technical deep-dive for Novara - pick one slot

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call: technical deep-dive for Novara - pick one slot

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next step:

What I heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on nightly batch extraction and enable a low-latency feature for customer chat.
- Constraints: must stay within their current VPC for compliance, want predictable throughput (50–100 reqs/s) and 30‑day log retention.
- Success metric: P95 latency < 250ms for inference and under $0.02/token operational target.

Recommended next step
- Technical deep-dive with your engineering and our infra team (15–30m). We'll show a config sketch, expected latency/cost tradeoffs, and a short rollout plan. This is not a full install—just engineering alignment.

Please pick one of these micro-slots. If we don't hear back by EOD Thursday (PST) we'll release them to other folks to keep momentum:
- Option A: Tue 6/1 09:00–09:15 PT (12:00–12:15 ET) — quick focused walkthrough
- Option B: Tue 6/1 14:30–14:45 PT (17:30–17:45 ET) — later in day

Calendar links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novara-deep-dive
Attachments: Novara-initial-proposal.pdf (high-level sizing & cost assumptions)

If either works, I'll lock it and send an invite with an agenda. If you need 30m instead, let me know now and we'll open a 30m slot but need a firm yes within 24 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
